description: Telemetry for one sapphire stage, with the anomaly gate boundaries carried on every row so the chart can shade (ttr, rampdown_start]. Concentration comes from the channel the auto-selector chose for the well, not a hardcoded denso.
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS timestamp) AS start_ts,
         CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp) AS end_ts,
         CAST(s.ttr_ts AS timestamp) AS gate_start_ts,
         CAST(s.rampdown_start_ts AS timestamp) AS gate_end_ts
  FROM featurestore:nextier_substage_sapphire_sept3_stage_summary_v2 s
  WHERE s.well_name = :well_name
    AND CAST(s.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) = CAST(:stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST(t.name AS TEXT) || ':' || CAST(t.record_ts AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id,
       t.name AS well_name, t.record_ts AS timestamp,
       CAST(:stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num,
       t.press_mainline, t.rate_slurry,
       CASE (SELECT wc.concentration_feature FROM featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 wc
             WHERE wc.well_name = :well_name)
         WHEN 'inline' THEN t.prop_conc_inline
         WHEN 'target' THEN t.prop_conc_target
         WHEN 'denso'  THEN t.prop_conc_blend_denso
         ELSE t.prop_conc_blend_auger END AS selected_concentration,
       b.gate_start_ts, b.gate_end_ts
FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 t
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE t.name = :well_name
  AND t.record_ts >= b.start_ts AND t.record_ts <= b.end_ts
ORDER BY t.record_ts
) q
